title: rungia paxiana
intro: Rungia paxiana, commonly known as Rungia, is a plant species found in the tropical regions of Asia, belonging to the family Lamiaceae. The plant is known for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which can help in reducing oxidative stress and inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of Rungia include its ability to act as an antibacterial and antifungal agent, making it effective in treating various infections and skin conditions. Bioactive constituents found in Rungia include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
